topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can’t believe this. Everything we shared, the hours talking late into the night, it was all just... coincidence? To think I trusted them, bared my thoughts, and they were right here the whole time. How could they not say something? The city’s not that big, it’s not like we’d run into each other at every corner, but still. Now I see them everywhere, like they’re following me, but when I confront them, they play innocent. No texts, no calls. I can’t shake the feeling that they’re hiding something. What’s the point of having friends if they’re going to do this? I don’t need this in my life.
